info.name: DavoChain – Customer Journey
info.description: Every customer endpoint in journey order. Tokens are saved and refreshed automatically. Guide: api/docs/CUSTOMER_JOURNEY_API_GUIDE.md. Start: set {{baseUrl}}, {{email}} (your inbox), {{phone}} (unused), then run 2. Account › Register.

exec: // Public and admin requests don't use the customer token.

console.warn("Sign in again: run '2. Account › Log in'. (Refresh answered " + res.code + ': ' + res.text() + ')');

item.name: 0. Setup for local testing (admin)
item.description: Only for testing on your computer with the pretend providers. Fill {{adminEmail}} and {{adminPassword}}, run this once; the admin token lasts 8 hours. The admin-only helper requests sit inside the journey where you need them (marked "admin, local test only").

exec: if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', j.accessToken); console.log('Admin signed in.'); }
else console.warn('No accessToken: if two-step sign-in is on for this admin, use an admin without it for local tests.');

request.description: Saves {{adminToken}}.

item.name: 2. Account
item.description: Register or log in first; the collection then keeps the tokens fresh by itself.

exec: if (j.userId !== undefined && j.userId !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', j.userId);

request.description: Use your own email in the {{email}} variable to receive the code. Phone must be unique.
Gives a new access AND refresh token; both are saved. The old refresh token stops working.

exec: if (j.id !== undefined && j.id !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', j.id);

request.description: Put the 6-digit code from the email in {{emailCode}}.

item.name: 3b. Transaction PIN (new 29 Oct 2026)
item.description: A 4-digit PIN asked for (header X-Transaction-Pin) on trades, withdrawals and sends. Make it once here; {{pin}} is used everywhere after. Guide: docs/TRANSACTION_PIN.md

request.description: isSet, lockedUntil, triesLeft.
Needs the account password. Easy PINs (1234, 0000, 1212…) answer 400 PIN_WEAK.
Afterwards set the {{pin}} variable to the new PIN.

item.name: Forgot PIN 1: email me a code

request.description: A 6-digit code goes to the email. Put it in {{pinResetCode}}.
Sends and withdrawals then wait (COOLING_OFF), like after a password change. Set {{pin}} to the new PIN.

item.description: After APPROVED, every session ends: run "2. Account › Log in" again.

request.description: Pretend Dojah: a BVN starting 333 is "Someone Clean, 1995-03-03". Each number verifies one account only.

item.name: 5. Naira account number
item.description: No BVN needed (since 23 Oct): the account opens by itself after Basic approval. Run Get, then the simulator.

item.name: Get my naira account number (opens it if needed, no BVN)
